items.title: Use the canonical full-suite budget in the result artifact
items.context: Replace the numeric shadow copy in full-suite-runner.ts with FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS and add a focused smoke assertion that rejects a future hard-coded performanceBudgetMs value.
items.userSees: The full-suite JSON result contains `"performanceBudgetMs": 1200000`, and `npm run test:full-suite-runner-smoke` prints `full-suite-runner-smoke: PASS`.
excludes: Changing FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS or runtime budget enforcement
Changing scheduler concurrency or entry timeouts

happy.desc: Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:full-suite-runner-smoke with the result field mapped as performanceBudgetMs: FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS → exits 0 and prints full-suite-runner-smoke: PASS, proving the result artifact derives its budget telemetry from the canonical constant.

adversarial.desc: Temporarily mutate only the result-field initializer from performanceBudgetMs: FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS to performanceBudgetMs: 300_000 and run npm --prefix packages/main run test:full-suite-runner-smoke → exits nonzero because the numeric shadow copy is rejected; restore the exact original initializer and rerun → prints full-suite-runner-smoke: PASS, with no production-file diff remaining.
